Class NodeSection

java.lang.Object
QueueNet.NodeSection
Direct Known Subclasses:
PipeSection
public abstract class NodeSection extends Object
This class implements a generic section of a NetNode.
Author:
Francesco Radaelli, Stefano Omini

  • Constructor Details

    • NodeSection

      public NodeSection(byte id)
      Creates a new instance of this NodeSection. Note that, while building a new node section, node owner informations are not available. To set node section properties depending on the owner node ones, the "nodeLiked(...)" protected method should be used.
      Parameters:
      id - NodeSection identifier.

    • NodeSection

      public NodeSection(byte id, boolean auto)
      Creates a new instance of this NodeSection. Note that, while building a new node section, node owner informations are not available. To set node section properties depending on the owner node ones, the "nodeLiked(...)" protected method should be used.
      Parameters:
      id - NodeSection identifier.
      auto - Auto refresh of the jobsList attribute.

    • NodeSection

      public NodeSection(byte id, boolean auto, boolean nodeAuto)
      Creates a new instance of this NodeSection. Note that, while building a new node section, node owner informations are not available. To set node section properties depending on the owner node ones, the "nodeLiked(...)" protected method should be used.
      Parameters:
      id - NodeSection identifier.
      auto - Auto refresh of the jobsList attribute.
      nodeAuto - Auto refresh the jobsList attribute at node level

  • Method Details

    • nodeLinked

      protected void nodeLinked(NetNode node) throws NetException
      This method should be overridden to implement a specific behaviour of the node section when the node section itself is linked to the owner node. This method should be used to set node section properties depending on the owner node ones.
      Parameters:
      node - Owner node.
      Throws:
      NetException

    • analyze

      public void analyze(int name, JobClass jobClass, Measure measurement, boolean isServerType, int serverTypeId) throws NetException
      Analyzes a measure in the node section. Override this method to analyze a measure depending on the node section implementation. Note that the first 256 identifiers are reserved by NodeSection class.
      Parameters:
      name - name of the measure to be activated (see measures constants).
      jobClass - Job class to be analyzed.
      measurement - Set of measure to be activated.
      isServerType - the is server type
      serverTypeId - the server type id
      Throws:
      NetException

    • isMyOwnerNode

      public boolean isMyOwnerNode(NetNode node)
      Checks if the specified node is the owner node of this section. Note that this method could be called only after that the owner node has been linked to this section.
      Parameters:
      node - node to be checked.
      Returns:
      True if the node is the owner node, false otherwise.
